product.name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Aerial Turquoise Blue Beach Photo of Mediterranean Beach 24" x 36"
product.description: A classic beach scene is given a contemporary twist with this overhead shot of sunbathers. Breath-taking turquoise water and bright white sand will add a pop of color to your wall and remind you of happy times with friends and family. Contemporary photo of a timeless subject Hand-stretched canvas on wood. Ready to hang with hardware included. 24"x 36" Made to order
